variables.description: The endpoint shown in Titer → Settings → AI connections while the server is on (usually http://127.0.0.1:18741/mcp). Copy it from Settings — do not guess the port.
variables.name: TITER_MCP_URL
variables.title: Titer MCP endpoint

variables.description: The local token shown in Titer → Settings → AI connections (Show → Copy). It stays valid until you regenerate it in Settings. Keep it private — never share it or commit it.
variables.name: TITER_MCP_TOKEN
variables.title: Titer local token
